scope: Read-only independent static review, no inherited approvals; native whole maps plus actual-size entry/middle/exit crops

early.01: Church, bench, barrels and all corners complete; quiet combat field; no proven cut module.
early.03: Complete church entry, repeated complete house bays, whole van and terminal industrial door; lower perimeter remains in low camera. Texture is strong but no proven checker/cut object.
early.04: Whole workbenches/crate pile; north shutter/wall and south industrial closure plausible. Repeating masonry lattice is stronger than quiet field, P2 aesthetic concern.
early.05: Singular complete gabled warehouse, whole Santa and barrel/crate props; foreground/corners continuous. Regular horizontal concrete joints are noticeable, no isolated assembly defect proven.

routes.06A: Complete inlet arch/water, continuous blue service pipe and wall; complete shelter stair/tarp exit and bottom canal/corners. Floor cadence regular but not a checker.
routes.06B: Closed/collapse/open images preserve gate posts, valve placements and original floor. No proof of partial-machinery stamp. Runtime contact/gate collision still needs controller review.
routes.12: Entry garage and exit union hall singular and complete, intermediate bay modules joined; bottom railing and corners physically continuous.

limitations: Static review does not prove collision, animation state handoff or temporal VRAM.
Architectural viewpoint may crop a whole object at viewport edge; that is separate from amputated art.
Material repetition alone does not establish assembly corruption.
